title: Lower bound for edge decoding
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with $q$ labels, let $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, and choose a table of Boolean functions on the Boolean cube, a default label, a vertex, one of its neighbors, and a coordinate. Suppose the coordinate has stable influence greater than $\varepsilon$ in the neighbor-averaged function at the vertex, and its image under the inverse constraint permutation has stable influence at least $\varepsilon/2$ in the neighboring table function. Then the decoding value on this directed edge is at least $\varepsilon^4/9$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game with $q$ labels
